node.title: can't read the 2nd input file
node.author: perl_boy
node.doctext: Hi, I'm failling to read the 2nd input file in citrix-enum-apps-xml-PORT-STATE-SERVICE+IP-disk.pl in the while loop line 11 die "perl citrix-enum-apps-xml-PORT-STATE-SERVICE+IP-disk.pl " if $#ARGV < 2; open(F0, $ARGV[0]); open(F1, $ARGV[1]); open(F2, ">>$ARGV[2]"); $line_no=$line_stop=0; while () { s/\r\n//; /^[0-9]+/; $line=$'; $line_no=$&; while ( && $line_stop++ < $line_no) { s/\r\n//; } print F2 $_, "\t$line\n" if /[0-9]+\//; } close F0; close F1; close F2; I have tried to replace that line 11 with while ( && $line_stop++ < $line_no) { s/\r\n//;print $_; } but nothing comes out what's wrong ? Remember I have already one input file openned F0 the idea of the script is to replace the line number (3 and 5 here) in port.txt input file 3 PORT state protocol 3 80/tcp closed http 3 443/tcp closed https 3 8080/tcp open http-proxy 5 80/tcp open http 5 443/tcp filtered https 5 8080/tcp filtered http-proxy and get the IP corresponding to the nth ($line_stop) (3 and 5 here) IP by 1.0.131.74 and 1.0.138.154 1.0.129.197 1.0.131.49 1.0.131.74 1.0.138.143 1.0.138.154 1.0.139.72 to produce 1.0.131.74 80/tcp closed http 1.0.131.74 443/tcp closed https 1.0.131.74 8080/tcp open http-proxy 1.0.138.154 80/tcp open http 1.0.138.154 443/tcp filtered https 1.0.138.154 8080/tcp filtered http-proxy any ideas ? thank's
